instruction: Check all tmux worker sessions in Terminal and save the result as JSON to "$HOME/Desktop/tmux_result_6_2.json". Set "completed" to the names of completed tmux sessions, set "running" to the names of still-running tmux sessions, and set "errored" to the names of tmux sessions with errors.

command: tmux new-session -d -s "tmux-worker-e2c" "printf '%s\\n' 'ERROR: failed to acquire lock' 'TMUX_ERROR_6B'; tail -f /dev/null"

reference_command:
python3 - <<'PY' > "$HOME/Desktop/tmux_result_6_2.json"
import json
import subprocess
sessions = ['tmux-worker-e2a', 'tmux-worker-e2b', 'tmux-worker-e2c']
completed = []
running = []
errored = []
for session in sessions:
    out = subprocess.check_output(['tmux', 'capture-pane', '-t', session, '-p'], text=True)
    if 'ERROR:' in out:
        errored.append(session)
    elif 'finished successfully' in out:
        completed.append(session)
    else:
        running.append(session)
print(json.dumps({'completed': completed, 'running': running, 'errored': errored}))
PY
